rejection_reason: OutputCoverage@20 dropped to 58.0% (29/50), which is below naive Top-20 baseline coverage (60.0%, 30/50). The selector discarded gold evidence for 16 queries out of the 45 present in B=200 (retention = 64.4%), reducing the downstream theoretical reranking ceiling from 90.0% to 58.0%.

provenance.description: Parameters max_per_sec=3 and adj_penalty=0.03 were not fitted or selected on TRAIN_VAL. They were manually chosen heuristics based on inspecting DEV-A crowding failure queries (such as V5-RNK-DEV-A-0049 and 0015) where multiple consecutive review chunks crowded out gold passages. Although the heuristics rescued specific queries (e.g. DEV-A-0009), they aggressively discarded gold chunks for other queries where valid evidence was located deeper within the same section, causing net negative retention.
